CENTRAL Station.
December 4 192 2

REPORT ON The History of the Rebellion of Chen Chuin Iing
(陳炯明)

Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by J. Gwens A.J.

Sir,

A copy of "The history of the rebellion of Chen
Chuin Iing 陳炯明叛國史" was obtained by a Police agent at
44 Route Vallon, Frenchtown, the headquarters of Dr. Sun
Yat Sen's staff, on December 3, and on December 4, a copy
was bought by C.D.U. 93 Pei Li Pih (潘連璧) at the office
of the Chinese newspaper Ming Kuo Pao (民國報), 13-15
Honan Road.

This is probably the publication about which
the Deputy Commissioner of Police received information from
the Hongkong Government in September last and which is
believed to have been edited by Dr. Sun Yat Sen and to
contain scurrilous matter. There is nothing in the book
to show who are the editors, publishers, or printers.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. Sullivan
D. I.

D. C. I. 16 . 12 . 22
Sir. Translation of extracts
attached. cf. 63.
J. Gwensal

1922年12月4日

关于陈炯明叛乱史的報告

由 D. I. Sullivan 制作，经 J. Gwens A.J. 转呈。

先生，

一名警务密探于12月3日在法租界华伦路（Route Vallon）44号——即孙中山博士参谋总部所在地——获取了一本《陈炯明叛国史》。12月4日，刑事侦缉处（C.D.U.）潘连璧（Pei Li Pih，音译）在河南路13-15号《民国报》馆购买了一本。

这很可能就是去年九月警务副总监从香港政府获得情报的那本出版物，据信由孙中山博士编辑，内含诽谤性内容。书中没有任何信息显示编者、出版者或印刷者是谁。

此致，
敬礼，
J. Sullivan
侦探督察（D. I.）

刑事侦缉处总监（D. C. I.） 1922年12月16日

CENTRAL
October 6 192 2

REPORT ON Book Written by Dr. Sun Yat Sen

Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by I.R.Givens A.J.

Sir,

Enquiries have been made in the International
Settlement and by the French Police in the French
Concession but nothing can be ascertained to confirm
the report that a scurrilous book which is alleged to have
been written by Dr. Sun Yat Sen attacking General Chen
Chuin Ming(陳炯明) and Yip Keiu(葉舉) is being
published locally. The Intelligence Press, 91 Honan Road,
and 138 Rue Hua who do most of the local printing for the
Cantonese and Kuo-Ming-Tang parties state that they have
had many enquiries for the book, but that they know
nothing about it and are of opinion that it is not being
published in Shanghai. A watch is being kept for news
of the book.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. I. Sullivan.
D. I.

D. U. I.

关于孙中山博士所著书籍的報告

由 D. I. Sullivan 制作，经 I.R.Givens A.J. 转呈。

先生，

已在国际租界内并通过法租界法国警务处进行调查，但无法证实有关传闻，即一本据称由孙中山博士撰写、攻击陈炯明将军（Chen Chuin Ming）和叶举（Yip Keiu）的诽谤性书籍正在本地出版。位于河南路91号和霞飞路（Rue Hua）138号的情报印刷社（Intelligence Press）承担了大部分粤系及国民党方面的本地印刷业务，他们表示虽有许多人询问此书，但他们对此一无所知，并认为该书并非在上海出版。目前正密切留意有关该书的最新消息。

此致，
敬礼，
D. I. Sullivan.
侦探督察（D. I.）

D. U. I.

September 15, 1922.
The Director of Criminal Intelligence.
The Hongkong Government having information
that Sun Yat-sen has written a scurrilous book
about Chen Chiung-ming and Yip Keui with the
intention of discrediting them in the South.
Before leaving Canton Sun arranged for
the book to be printed in the office of the Shun
Po Newspaper in Hongkong. Notice in re is
attached.
This the Hongkong Government have prohibited
and it is now reported that the book is to be
published in the French Settlement. Please make
enquiries and return attached notice as soon as
possible.
Deputy Commissioner of Police.

致刑事侦缉处处长。

香港政府获悉，孙中山撰写了一本关于陈炯明和叶举（Yip Keui）的诽谤性书籍，意图在南方败坏他们的名声。
孙中山在离开广州前，安排将该书在香港《顺报》（Shun Po Newspaper）馆印刷。相关通告附后。

HISTORY OF CHEN CHUING MING'S TREACHERY
(The three compilers named Zia Sheng Ts, 谢盛子
Lu Ziah Ts:鲁直子 and Li Kuin Sien 李鲤仙 of
the book entitled "History of Chen Chuing
Iing's Treachery" had evidently sent copies
to various prominent Kuomingtangs seeking
their opinions. Quite a number complied,
some giving their views at great length,
others simply writing an autograph note in a
few pity words. All these notes and opinions,
are published at the beginning of the book,
the notes being printed in large characters,
each note occupying a page.)
Extracts from the above book:
In the course of his opinion, which
is a lengthy one, Cheng Chi 張治 says:--"Chen
Chuing Iing is an offender against the Republic
as well as an offender against the principles
of human relationship. Unless this traitor
is removed the civilization of the West River
(in Kwangtung) will take the path of wild
beasts."
An autograph note by Yang Hu 楊虎 reads:--
"Nationals all say that he (Chen Chuing Iing) de
deserves to be executed."
An autograph note by Sun Ko 孫科
(son of Sun Yat Sen) reads:--"This is more
severe than punishment with an axe."
4777
8/1/23.
page_data.zh:
陈炯明叛变史
（题为《陈炯明叛变史》一书的三位编纂者谢盛子、鲁直子和李鲤仙显然已将样书寄给多位国民党知名人士征求意见。不少人予以回复，有的长篇大论阐述观点，有的仅寥寥数语题写亲笔留言。所有这些留言和意见均刊印在书首，留言采用大字排版，每条留言独占一页。）
摘自上述书籍：
张治（Cheng Chi，音译）在其长篇意见中说道：“陈炯明既是共和制的罪人，也是人伦关系的罪人。除非铲除这个叛徒，西江（在广东）的文明将堕入禽兽之道。”
杨虎的亲笔留言写道：“国人皆曰他（陈炯明）死有余辜。”
孙科（孙中山之子）的亲笔留言写道：“此甚于斧钺之诛。”
4777
1923年1月8日。

page_data.en:
EXTRACTS FROM THE BOOK.
A proclamation issued by the Commander
of the Kwangtung Naval Defence.

Chen Chiung Ming, the offender against
human relationship, has a heart as cruel as
that of a vulture and a nature as wild as that
of a wolf. On June 16 he led his men to invade
the Presidential Residence, expelled the
members of the parliament and plundered the
houses of the people for a distance of several
hundred li. Wherever the ruthless soldiers
went nine houses out of ten were emptied. Acts
which the most wicked robbers would not dare to commit
were boldly committed by Chen's men. When the
Northern Expeditionary Force was just about
to enter Kwangsi Chen, who was then Minister
of War suddenly betrayed his party and went
to the side of Li Yuan Hung in order to advance
his personal ambition. Chen was a member of
the Kuomintang Party yet he violated the
principles of the Kuomintang and attempted
to murder his leader whom, for the past 20
years he had looked upon as his father and tutor
and who escaped death in the Ching Dynasty, at
the hands of Yuan Shih Kai and his followers.
Chen is a native of Kwangtung. It is his duty
to protect his native place, but instead of
doing so he has plundered it and allowed his
men to rob the people and even rape family women.
Chen is truly worse than a beast. What even Lok
Yoong Ding and Hon Yoong Sing would not do has
been done by Chen. The calamities brought upon
Kwangtung Province are entirely due to Chen. Our
Marshal (Sun Yat Sen) started the revolution

陈炯明这个人伦罪人，心肠如秃鹫般残忍，本性如狼般野蛮。6月16日，他率部入侵总统府，驱逐国会议员，并在数百里范围内掠夺民宅。残暴士兵所到之处，十室九空。连最邪恶的强盗都不敢做的勾当，陈的部下却大胆为之。当北伐军即将进入广西时，时任陆军部长的陈突然背叛党派，转而投靠黎元洪，以推进其个人野心。陈是国民党党员，却违反国民党原则，企图谋杀其领袖；过去二十年间，他一直视这位领袖为父为师，而这位领袖曾在清朝及袁世凯及其追随者手中死里逃生。陈是广东人，保卫家乡是他的职责，但他非但没有这样做，反而掠夺家乡，纵容部下抢劫百姓，甚至强奸良家妇女。陈确实比野兽还不如。连乐永鼎（Lok Yoong Ding，音译）和韩永成（Hon Yoong Sing，音译）都不屑做的事，陈却做了。给广东省带来的灾难完全归咎于陈。我们的元帅（孙中山）发动革命

page_data.en:
and fought hard for a Republic. He was about
to succeed in his work when Chen suddenly betrayed
his Government and spoiled the Republican Government.
Our work for the past several years will be lost
should this traitor be allowed to remain in our
province. Kwangtung Province has suffered the
most in establishing the Chinese Republic. Chen,
the traitor, not only would not do his part for his
province but did all his best to bring disaster
upon Kwangtung Province. This is what we regret
the most. I, being the commander of the Naval
Defence, must be obedient to the Chief and loyal
to the Republic, which had not been easily established.
I swear to crush the cruel traitor and to save the
country and Kwangtung Province. I will abide by
my principles even to the extent of losing my life.
I therefore issue this proclamation to protest
against Chen and wish the elders and brethren
of the province will support me and assist me to
behead the traitor in order that the country may be at
peace. This is my sincere hope".

A Proclamation issued by Li Fu-lin,
Vanguard of Sun Yat-sen's Army.

In betraying his colleague and allying
himself with our opponents, Chen Chiung-ming
deserves a more severe punishment than death.
Our Great President treated him with every kindness
and excused him on many occasions, but Chen
instead of doing him a good turn even attempted
to murder him by attacking the President's residence.
He also allowed his soldiers to plunder the people
and to rape our sisters. Wherever the traitor's
soldiers go the people have suffered heavily and
their homes are emptied of valuables. The duty
page_data.zh:
并为共和国奋力战斗。他的事业即将成功之际，陈突然背叛政府，破坏了共和政府。如果允许这个叛徒留在我们省内，我们过去几年的工作将付诸东流。在建立中华民国的过程中，广东省遭受的苦难最深。叛徒陈不仅不为本省尽责，反而竭尽全力给广东省带来灾难。这是我们要最为痛惜的。我身为海防司令，必须服从元首，忠于来之不易的共和国。我发誓要粉碎这个残酷的叛徒，拯救国家和广东省。我将坚守原则，哪怕牺牲生命。因此，我发布此告示以抗议陈的行径，并希望全省父老兄弟支持我，协助我斩首叛徒，以使国家安宁。这是我的诚挚愿望”。

孙中山军队先锋李福林（Li Fu-lin，音译）发布的告示。

陈炯明背叛同僚并与我们的敌人结盟，其罪行死不足惜。我们的大总统对他百般优待，多次宽恕他，但陈非但不思报答，反而通过攻击总统府企图谋杀总统。他还纵容士兵掠夺百姓，强奸我们的姐妹。叛军士兵所到之处，百姓深受其害，家中 valuables（贵重物品）被洗劫一空。职责

page_data.en:
a soldier is to protect the people, but his
men have brought down many calamities upon
the people. Such a man must not be allowed
to exist so I swear to fight against him until
I succeed in putting him to an end. I hereby
issue this proclamation and hope my men will
support me with all their might.

The following circular telegram was
despatched by Sung Tao Han, Commander of the
"Righteous Force" to suppress Chen Chuin Ying's
men:

Chen Chuin Ying has secretly allied himself
with Pu Pei Fu, caused disturbances in the Province,
invaded the President's residence, expelled the
President, insulted Parliament, caused the death
of old Government Officials, plundered the people,
and violated the law. He is a most sinful fellow.
Should he be not executed the 400 million Chinese
brethren are beasts. I swear to kill this traitor
in order to wipe off the disgrace. As I have
just been appointed by President Sun as the
Commander of the "Righteous Force to suppress
Chen Chuin Ying and his men" I will lead my
men to attack him without the least delay and
will not cease fighting until Chen Chuin Ying
has been killed.
page_data.zh:
军人本应保护百姓，但其部下却给百姓带来了诸多灾难。此种人决不容其存世，故我发誓与之抗争，直至将其彻底铲除。特此发布告示，望我部将士全力支援。

宋涛汉（音译），“讨陈军”司令，为镇压陈楚英（音译）部，发出如下通电解文：

陈楚英（音译）暗中勾结浦佩孚（音译），在省内制造骚乱，闯入总统府，驱逐总统，侮辱国会，致使前政府官员死亡，掠夺百姓，违法乱纪。实乃罪大恶极之徒。若不将此贼处决，四亿同胞皆为禽兽。我发誓杀死此叛徒，以雪耻辱。鉴于我刚刚被孙总统任命为“讨伐陈楚英及其部下的正义之师”司令，我将立即率部进攻，不获全胜、不杀陈楚英（音译）决不收兵。
